description: watchdog.list is a list-with-details (rule 3): each rule carries its threshold in the signal's own human unit (the unit the vocabulary serves — ms for the two time signals, the bare count for the two count signals — never a client assumption), its fire side (how often it has fired and when — the loops' own control audit), and the loops currently in an episode under it: the loops its once-per-episode memory says it will not re-fire for until they make progress. The scope filter narrows to one tree, so a client that asks for a component's rules gets exactly the rules that cover it and its tree.
